definition: Human missense SNVs with ClinVar P/LP labels as positives and B/LB labels as negatives. Each model scores the variants without training on the labels (zero-shot or precomputed scores); a single global AUROC is computed over the missense set. ClinVar release, review-star filter and variant intersection differ between members, so numbers are expected to be close, not identical.
name: ClinVar missense SNVs, pathogenic/likely pathogenic versus benign/likely benign, AUROC

definition: ClinVar P/LP versus B/LB missense or protein-altering SNVs scored by area under the precision-recall curve. AUPRC depends on the positive fraction, which differs between every member, so this groups the family without claiming numeric comparability.
name: ClinVar missense SNVs, pathogenic versus benign, AUPRC (family only)

definition: BRCA1 saturation genome editing SNVs with Findlay et al. 2018 functional classes; loss-of-function (LOF) variants are positives and functional or intermediate (FUNC, INT) variants are negatives. Each model scores the variants without training on the labels; one global AUROC over the all-SNV stratum (3,893 SNVs).
name: BRCA1 SGE, all SNVs, LOF versus FUNC/INT, AUROC

definition: BRCA1 saturation genome editing SNVs with Findlay et al. 2018 functional classes; loss-of-function (LOF) variants are positives and functional or intermediate (FUNC, INT) variants are negatives. Each model scores the variants without training on the labels; one global AUROC over the coding-SNV stratum (2,768 SNVs).
name: BRCA1 SGE, coding SNVs, LOF versus FUNC/INT, AUROC

definition: BRCA1 saturation genome editing SNVs with Findlay et al. 2018 functional classes; loss-of-function (LOF) variants are positives and functional or intermediate (FUNC, INT) variants are negatives. Each model scores the variants without training on the labels; one global AUROC over the noncoding-SNV stratum (1,125 SNVs).
name: BRCA1 SGE, noncoding SNVs, LOF versus FUNC/INT, AUROC

definition: BRCA1 missense variants with Findlay et al. 2018 saturation genome editing classes as truth; each predictor score is cut at a threshold and the call is compared with the functional class (likelihood ratios, sensitivity, specificity).
name: BRCA1 SGE missense variants, thresholded predictor calls against functional class (family only)

definition: Missense predictor scores calibrated by local posterior probability of pathogenicity in a sliding score window, prior 0.0441, with one-sided 95% bootstrap bounds; reported as the score threshold reaching each evidence strength for PP3 and BP4.
name: ClinGen PP3/BP4 score thresholds from local posterior calibration (Pejaver 2022 method)

definition: Missense variants seen frequently in COSMIC (> 0.1%) as positives against gnomAD common missense variants as negatives; zero-shot variant scores; AUPRC.
name: COSMIC frequent somatic missense versus gnomAD common missense, AUPRC

definition: ClinVar P/LP versus B/LB small insertions and deletions, all genomic contexts pooled, scored without training on the labels; global AUROC.
name: ClinVar indels, pathogenic versus benign, AUROC

definition: All 217 ProteinGym DMS substitution assays at upstream commit 144fe22 (v1.3). The model scores each variant without any training on the assay labels. Spearman correlation between scores and DMS fitness per assay, rounded to three decimals, then averaged with the official ProteinGym aggregation (mean by UniProt ID and selection type, then equal weight per selection-type category).
name: ProteinGym v1.3 DMS substitutions, zero-shot, Spearman, official average over 217 assays

definition: One ProteinGym DMS substitution assay, AMFR_HUMAN_Tsuboyama_2023_4G3O (stability, 2,972 variants), at upstream commit 144fe22. Zero-shot scores for every variant, Spearman correlation against the DMS score for that one assay. No aggregation. Not a suite score.
name: ProteinGym AMFR_HUMAN_Tsuboyama_2023_4G3O single assay, zero-shot, Spearman

definition: The AMFR_HUMAN_Tsuboyama_2023_4G3O assay (2,972 variants) at ProteinGym v1.3 / commit 144fe22, scored zero-shot; AUROC against the official binarised DMS labels (official_DMS_score_bin) for that one assay. No aggregation.
name: ProteinGym AMFR_HUMAN_Tsuboyama_2023_4G3O single assay, zero-shot, AUROC

definition: The AMFR_HUMAN_Tsuboyama_2023_4G3O assay (2,972 variants) at ProteinGym v1.3 / commit 144fe22, scored zero-shot; MCC against the official binarised DMS labels (official_DMS_score_bin) for that one assay. No aggregation.
name: ProteinGym AMFR_HUMAN_Tsuboyama_2023_4G3O single assay, zero-shot, MCC

definition: The AMFR_HUMAN_Tsuboyama_2023_4G3O assay (2,972 variants) at ProteinGym v1.3 / commit 144fe22, scored zero-shot; NDCG at 10% against the official binarised DMS labels (official_DMS_score_bin) for that one assay. No aggregation.
name: ProteinGym AMFR_HUMAN_Tsuboyama_2023_4G3O single assay, zero-shot, NDCG at 10%

definition: The AMFR_HUMAN_Tsuboyama_2023_4G3O assay (2,972 variants) at ProteinGym v1.3 / commit 144fe22, scored zero-shot; top 10% recall against the official binarised DMS labels (official_DMS_score_bin) for that one assay. No aggregation.
name: ProteinGym AMFR_HUMAN_Tsuboyama_2023_4G3O single assay, zero-shot, top 10% recall

definition: All MFASS mutant SNVs with a v2 exon-inclusion-change measurement (27,733 variants, 1,050 splice-disrupting at an inclusion drop of at least 0.50, 3.79%). Each sequence-based predictor scores the variant in hg38 genomic context, tissue-agnostically, with no training on MFASS and no held-out split. Scored by average precision (and AUROC) over the whole cohort.
name: MFASS splice-disrupting variant detection, full labelled cohort, average precision

definition: 213 patient variants in ABCA4 (deep intronic and noncanonical splice site) and MYBPC3 (noncanonical splice site) whose splicing effect was measured in mini- or midigene assays in HEK293T cells. Each tool's score is thresholded (tuned on the same data) and scored by sensitivity and specificity against the assay label, pooled over all 213 variants.
name: Riepe et al. ABCA4 and MYBPC3 minigene-tested variants, binary splice-alteration classification, sensitivity and specificity

definition: Sequence-level classification on the Nucleotide Transformer benchmark splice-site dataset (acceptor). The model is fine-tuned (or trained) on the dataset's training data and scored on held-out data by Matthews correlation coefficient; NT benchmark reports the median over 10 cross-validation folds.
name: Nucleotide Transformer benchmark splice acceptor classification, fine-tuned, MCC

definition: Sequence-level classification on the Nucleotide Transformer benchmark splice-site dataset (donor). The model is fine-tuned (or trained) on the dataset's training data and scored on held-out data by Matthews correlation coefficient; NT benchmark reports the median over 10 cross-validation folds.
name: Nucleotide Transformer benchmark splice donor classification, fine-tuned, MCC

definition: Sequence-level classification on the Nucleotide Transformer benchmark splice-site dataset (all sites). The model is fine-tuned (or trained) on the dataset's training data and scored on held-out data by Matthews correlation coefficient; NT benchmark reports the median over 10 cross-validation folds.
name: Nucleotide Transformer benchmark splice all sites classification, fine-tuned, MCC

definition: GUE splice site prediction dataset: models are fine-tuned on the GUE training split and scored on its test split by MCC.
name: GUE splice site prediction (Reconstruct), supervised fine-tuning, MCC
